feeds.title: City of Fitchburg, WI
feeds.description: The City of Fitchburg, Wisconsin is dedicated to keeping residents informed and up to date with the latest news and information about city services, community events, government policy and more.

feeds.title: Fitchburg Star
feeds.description: The Fitchburg Star, a community newspaper that has been proudly serving the Fitchburg area since 1974. It remains the definitive source of news for the community, covering city government, business, and features.
